title: Infernal: Blaze of Destruction (lore build)
summary: The Infernal Flame cards share a name but no engine, as the page says. Infernal Flame Emperor, the first of them, was the cover card of Structure Deck: Blaze of Destruction (2005). So this list is that deck, card for card, minus Pot of Greed and Heavy Storm (Forbidden). Its Pyro counterparts from later sets, Infernal Flame Vixen and Infernal Flame Banshee, are in the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Starters & Enablers
points: The Emperor's own structure deck, at its original counts: FIRE Pyros (Inferno, Solar Flare Dragon, Molten Zombie, Raging Flame Sprite, Gaia Soul the Combustible Collective, Fox Fire, Blazing Inpachi), FIRE Beasts (Great Angus, Little Chimera) and UFO Turtle, Ultimate Baseball Kid and Thestalos the Firestorm Monarch.
Its Spells and Traps, all generic: Molten Destruction, Backfire, Level Limit - Area B, Dust Tornado and the 2005 staples.
Extra Deck: Infernal Flame Vixen and Infernal Flame Banshee, the Rank 4 Pyro counterparts.

summary.title: Opening: UFO Turtle
steps: Normal Summon UFO Turtle in Attack Position (or Set it) under Molten Destruction.
When UFO Turtle is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY, activate its effect to Special Summon Solar Flare Dragon (or Ultimate Baseball Kid) from your Deck.
Summon a second Pyro monster (such as Blazing Inpachi or Fox Fire) to protect Solar Flare Dragon from attacks while burning 500 damage each End Phase.
Overlay two Level 4 Pyros to Xyz Summon Infernal Flame Banshee to search any Pyro monster from your Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & The Emperor's Blast
points: Infernal Flame Emperor is the cover boss: when Tribute Summoned, it banishes up to 5 FIRE monsters from your GY to destroy an equal number of Spell and Trap Cards on the field.
Thestalos the Firestorm Monarch discards a random card from the opponent's hand upon Tribute Summon, burning for 100 times the discarded monster's Level.
Infernal Flame Banshee (Rank 4 Pyro Xyz) detaches 1 material to add any Pyro monster from your Deck to your hand or send it to the GY.
Infernal Flame Vixen (Rank 4 Pyro Xyz) gains 100 ATK for each FIRE monster in your GY, and when destroyed by battle banishes 3 monsters from either player's GY.
Ultimate Baseball Kid gains 500 ATK for every other FIRE monster on the field, and can send a face-up FIRE monster to the GY to burn for 500 damage.

summary.title: Spells, Traps & Burn
points: Molten Destruction is the iconic Field Spell that boosts all FIRE monsters by 500 ATK and reduces their DEF by 400.
Backfire burns the opponent for 500 damage whenever a face-up FIRE monster you control is destroyed and sent to the GY.
Dark Room of Nightmare adds 300 damage each time the opponent takes effect damage, stacking with Solar Flare Dragon, Meteor of Destruction, and Backfire.
Level Limit - Area B shifts all Level 4 or higher monsters to Defense Position, stalling the board while Raging Flame Sprite attacks directly.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Pot of Greed and Heavy Storm were originally in Structure Deck: Blaze of Destruction, but are Forbidden under current Advanced format rules and omitted.
